Two men, one a Middle Eastern sales clerk and the other a Hispanic sales clerk, were both house hunting with their families. The Middle Eastern sales clerk's family is having a much harder time than the other family because they are using Section 8 vouchers to help pay for their housing instead of just going through the bank. Which family receives government benefits?
A. Cannot answer
B. The Hispanic sales clerk's family
C. The Middle Eastern sales clerk's family
